children: FiEE reported revenue of $9.6 million for the first nine months of 2026, up 382.1% year over year, and net income of $3.6 million compared with a loss a year earlier. Third-quarter revenue was $2.6 million, while net income was $1.1 million. The results reflect the company’s shift toward SaaS and other digital services.
$9.57 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared with $1.98 million in the prior-year period. Third-quarter revenue was $2.62 million, up from $1.94 million.
Nine-month gross profit was $7.30 million, with a gross margin of 76.3%, compared with $1.65 million and 83.0% a year earlier. Third-quarter gross profit was $1.93 million.
$3.82 million for the first nine months, versus an operating loss of $1.11 million in the prior-year period.
$3.58 million for the nine months, compared with a net loss of $1.27 million. Third-quarter net income was $1.12 million, versus a loss of $253,000.
$0.24 for the nine months, compared with a diluted loss of $0.25 in the prior-year period.
FiEE continued its strategic transition from legacy hardware operations toward a software-first model integrating AI and data analytics into content creation and brand management.
SaaS MCN digital services had onboarded 939 customers by September 30. The company reported cumulative service fees of $9.2 million, with $9.0 million recognized as revenue.
The software services customer base reached 32, an increase of one from June 30, 2026. The company reported contracts totaling $4.1 million.

Phygital art advisory services served five corporate clients and 601 individual clients during the period. FiEE also cited art advisory, acquisition assistance, exhibition, post-transaction support, and MCN brokerage services in connection with its creator and collector ecosystem.
